mapper.select: SELECT file_id, workspace_id, uploaded_by, original_name, stored_name, mime_type, size, width, height, file_url, created_at FROM files WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO files (workspace_id, uploaded_by, original_name, stored_name, mime_type, size, width, height, file_url) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{uploadedBy}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{mimeType}, #{size}, #{width}, #{height}, #{fileUrl})
